principle: Production geometry follows published FEFCO/EngView score-to-score relationships. Profile selects nominal board caliper; measured caliper may override it. Historical orders are diagnostic only.

formula.manufacturer_joint_mm: plant parameter; independent of flute formula

manufacturer_joint_note: Net dimensional contribution of the manufacturer's joint. This is deliberately separate from glue application width and glue gap. The default 37 mm is a local working value: it reproduces verified tech card #990 with the published score-to-score geometry and sits within common industry joint ranges. It remains editable.

sources.name: EngView Packaging Library — FEFCO 0201 Main Parameters
sources.use: Primary production geometry source. For inside dimensions: Lss=L+d, Lss1=L, Wss=B+d, Wss1=B+d/2, Hss=H+d.

sources.name: EngView Packaging Library — FEFCO 0201 Corrections Parameters
sources.use: Confirms that 90-degree fold corrections depend on material thickness and that the glue-joint correction is a separate correction.

sources.name: EngView Packaging Library — FEFCO 0201 Score-to-Score Parameters
sources.use: Confirms separate Lss/Lss1 and Wss/Wss1 dimensions and dependence on C90Y/GLC/LPC.

sources.name: BoxBlanks — FEFCO 0201
sources.use: Independent FEFCO-0201 geometry check: all four RSC flaps are half the breadth and the outer pair meet at the centre.

sources.name: Applied Sciences 2024 — corrugated board specimens
sources.use: Nominal/reference calipers used as defaults: E 1.73 mm, B 2.97 mm, C 4.02 mm, EB 4.19 mm, BC 6.72 mm. Actual measured plant caliper overrides these values.

sources.name: Sensors 2024 — double-wall corrugated geometry
sources.use: Reference measured EC/CE double-wall thickness 5.24 mm. Actual measured plant caliper overrides this value.

E.basis: Published measured specimen; replace with actual plant caliper when available.

B.basis: Published measured specimen; replace with actual plant caliper when available.

C.basis: Published measured specimen. With 37 mm manufacturer joint, the source-based formula reproduces tech card #990 to the production millimetre.

BE.basis: EB/BE double-wall reference specimen; flute order does not change the generic thickness-based 0201 score geometry in this model.

CE.basis: EC/CE double-wall reference specimen; actual plant caliper preferred.

BC.basis: Published BC double-wall specimen; actual plant caliper preferred.
